blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Foreign Affairs Secretary Maria Theresa Lazaro said China has maintained its commitment to completing a Code of Conduct (COC) in the South China Sea, warning that any change in its position would cause a stir among Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) members. Speaking at a press briefing on Monday, Lazaro said Chinese Premier Li Qiang’s remarks reaffirming cooperation with ASEAN were consistent with commitments previously made by Beijing. “Why do you think will the premier of China say anything that has not been said?
